description.narrative: The Partnership for Action on Green Economy (PAGE) is a coordinated response from five UN agencies (ILO, UNEP, UNIDO, UNITAR and UNDP) to the outcome of the United Nations Conference on Sustainable Development (Rio+20). PAGE delivers support on the basis of beneficiary countries' demand and demonstrated commitment to develop enabling policy and institutional frameworks on the inclusive green economy
